title: Sennacherib’s Palace Without Rival completed
summary: Sennacherib’s inscription of his third year says his Palace Without Rival at Nineveh was complete.
description: Sennacherib’s inscription of his third year says his Palace Without Rival at Nineveh was complete. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (section “Confirmation from the Lachish Reliefs”, pp. 25–26).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 702 BC (Sennacherib’s third year).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, section “Confirmation from the Lachish Reliefs”, pp. 25–26
chronologies.note: Inscription stating the Palace Without Rival at Nineveh was complete; the authors think it was probably accurate, the palace having been begun while he was crown prince.
